name: AWS Neuron docs: bert-base-uncased on trn1.2xlarge, real-time, 2085 inf/s (p50 0.94ms)
methodology: VENDOR-MEASURED (AWS Neuron docs, NeuronPerf). trn1.2xlarge, PyTorch 2.8, Neuron 2.26, Data Parallel run-mode, batch 1, seq_len 128, FP32 w/ Matmult-BF16 autocast. Encoder model — unit is inferences/sec, NOT tokens/sec.
notes: Encoder (BERT) row — counts whole-sequence inferences, not generative tokens. Included to record the vendor-published latency-optimized figure; not comparable to decode tok/s.
